method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equity Volatility Jumps Most Since April 2025 Tariff Turmoil
Equities.reason: Sharp one-day jump in equity volatility signals heightened risk-off sentiment and market stress — negative for equities broadly; medium-high relevance as it reinforces the selloff narrative.

Equities.title: Stocks tumble as AI panic sweeps markets, bonds draw haven demand
Equities.reason: Representative global piece linking a broad equity selloff to AI/regulatory panic and safe-haven flows into bonds — core market-regime negative with very high relevance.

Equities.title: Tech Rout Erases Record $2.3 Trillion in Value as AI Fears Grow
Equities.reason: Large headline market-cap losses concentrated in AI/tech leadership — negative for market leadership and the broader risk-on regime; high relevance because it quantifies the scale.

Equities.title: Investors wipe $2.5 trillion off Nasdaq as blue tsunami prompts AI fears
Equities.reason: Quantifies heavy losses in Nasdaq/AI-linked names tied to political/regulatory concerns — reinforces negative regime for US tech-led equities.

Equities.title: Wall Street sheds $3.2tn as tech-heavy Nasdaq plunges
Equities.summary: Tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 tumbles 6.4% in day of chaotic trading
Equities.reason: FT framing of a systemic, cross-market tech rout — important macro confirmation of a regime shift away from AI-led gains; very high relevance.

Equities.title: Wall Street's fear gauge surges the most since April. Why traders think it should be even higher
Equities.summary: From its intraday low to high Thursday, VIX moved more than 11 points, the biggest one-day move since April 9.
Equities.reason: VIX spike underscores increased tail-risk perception and a shift toward defensive positioning — negative for equities; medium-high relevance.

Equities.title: Nasdaq posts biggest daily drop in 19 months on fears of AI regulations
Equities.reason: Clear evidence of a technical correction in the market leader (Nasdaq) driven by regulatory/AI worries — negative for market breadth and momentum.

Equities.title: AI Selloff Drives Asian Stock Markets to Fresh Grim Milestones
Equities.reason: Shows contagion from US tech/AI selloff into Asian markets and large-cap leadership — negative for global risk-on and cross-regional equities.

Equities.title: Japanese investors snap up foreign long-term bonds as tech stocks slide
Equities.reason: Flow evidence of risk-off positioning (equities -> bonds) from retail/institutional sellers — supports negative market regime with medium relevance.

Equities.title: Korea’s $1.7 Trillion Rout Burns Day Traders, Challenges Lee
Equities.reason: Large, concentrated losses in South Korea highlight regional severity of the AI/tech unwind — negative for EM/Asia equity sentiment and leverage-driven flows.

Equities.title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
Equities.summary: Democratic winners and progressive lawmakers are calling for tougher limits on AI and data centers after the 2026 midterm elections.
Equities.reason: Policy/regulatory risk directly targets the AI/data-center growth narrative that had been a primary equity leadership driver — meaningful negative for sector and market leadership.

Equities.title: India as an AI hedge? The country's stocks could see robust inflows as markets globally tank
Equities.summary: Over the last month, India's Nifty 50 has gained nearly 9%, while markets with heavy AI exposure, including the U.S., Japan, South Korea and Taiwan are deep in the red.
Equities.reason: Potential regional rotation into India as an alternative to AI-heavy markets — modestly positive for India-specific equities but limited relevance to the global selloff narrative.

Equities.title: Analysts and investors react to AI market rout
Equities.reason: Market commentary captures sentiment drivers and investor positioning (risk-off, deleveraging) — negative for near-term equities with medium relevance.

Rates.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE raised Bank Rate to 4% — explicit tightening and hawkish shift. Directly increases UK yields and contributes to global higher-for-longer rate narrative; high relevance for Rates markets.

Rates.title: British Pound: BoE tightening bias supports higher rates – UOB
Rates.summary: UOB’s Lee Sue Ann notes that the Bank of England has resumed tightening, lifting the Bank Rate to 4.00% and signalling a hawkish shift as inflation risks re-emerge. The Nov Monetary Policy Report projects CPI near 5.0% by mid-2027 and only back to target in 3Q
Rates.reason: Analyst commentary reinforcing BoE hawkish bias and elevated inflation outlook — supports higher UK yields. Useful corroborating signal but secondary to official BoE release, so lower relevance.

Rates.title: Japan Bonds Rally as Global Risk-Off Move Boosts Haven Demand
Rates.reason: News of JGB rally reflects risk-off flows and lower yields (bond price rally). This is a direct market-driven move in rates — positive for bonds and offsets some hawkish central bank headlines.

Rates.title: China’s 10-Year Yield Hits Record Intraday Low on Haven Demand
Rates.reason: Record low in China 10-year yield signals strong haven bid and falling yields — sizable direct impact on rates in the region and indicative of broader demand for duration.

Rates.title: BOJ to hike in December, seek terminal rate of 2%, says ex-central bank top economist
Rates.reason: Commentary expecting BOJ tightening and a materially higher terminal rate would push JGB yields up and contribute to global upward pressure on yields — relevant forward-looking policy signal.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statement is a primary policy signal for US rates. Treated as modestly hawkish in the current context (supports higher-for-longer narrative), weighing on bond prices (yields up).

Rates.title: Malaysian Bonds Lure Buyers as Oil Squeezes Peers, Analysts Say
Rates.reason: Flows into Malaysian bonds show regional demand for duration as commodity moves affect peers — direct positive for bond prices locally; moderate relevance to EM rates story.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker suggests slightly higher wage growth in first three quarters of 2027 compared with the full year of 2026
Rates.reason: Higher wage growth in ECB tracker implies more persistent inflation risk for the euro area — supportive of higher euro-area yields (negative for bonds). Relevant macro signal for rates.

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions
Rates.reason: Official ECB monetary policy decisions are a direct influence on euro-area rates. Treated as mildly hawkish/neutral in the current mix, modestly weighing toward higher yields.

FX.title: Euro weakens to near 1.1200 as traders await US jobs data
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair loses ground to near 1.1215 during the early Asian session on Friday, pressured by a cautious mood. However, the potential downside for the pair might be limited amid the hawkish stance from the European Central Bank (ECB).
FX.reason: EUR weakness vs USD ahead of US jobs – directly USD-centric and reinforces a USD-strength/risk-off narrative; ECB hawkishness is noted but secondary to near-term USD flows.

FX.title: Euro extends losses in risk-off markets despite bright German Industrial Production
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) trades lower for the second consecutive day on Friday, with the US Dollar (USD) favoured by risk aversion amid a tech-led sell-off in equity markets.
FX.reason: Clear USD safe-haven bid amid tech-led equity rout driving EUR lower — high relevance as it ties FX moves to broad risk-off flows and DXY strength.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens ahead of US, Canadian jobs data releases
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair gains momentum to around 1.4050 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The US dollar (USD) edges higher against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on safe-haven demand after the US equity sell-off.
FX.reason: USD/CAD pushing higher on safe-haven USD flows; relevant because CAD is commodity-linked but near-term moves are driven by USD strength and risk-off ahead of jobs data.

FX.title: US Dollar Index (DXY) extends recovery to 101.80 ahead of US NFP report
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, gains some follow-through positive traction during the Asian session on Friday, recovering further from its lowest level since late September set the previous day.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move — primary USD indicator. Recovery ahead of NFP is highly relevant for FX regime (USD strength), driving cross-market flows and risk pricing.

FX.title: Australian Dollar drops on dovish RBA outlook, stronger US Dollar
FX.summary: AUD/USD remains subdued after registering over 1% losses the previous day, trading around 0.6910 during Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: AUD weakness attributed to dovish domestic central-bank tone and stronger USD — relevant for commodity-linked FX and broader USD-dominant narrative.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar softens below 0.5600, US NFP data looms
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair attracts some sellers to near 0.5585 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) extends its downside against the US Dollar (USD) due to soft employment data and political uncertainty in New Zealand.
FX.reason: NZD selling vs USD from domestic weakness and event risk; reinforces USD-strength/risk-off theme across Asia-Pacific FX.

FX.title: Japanese Yen retreats from weekly high as USD steadies ahead of US NFP report
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair stages a modest recovery from the 157.25 area, or fresh weekly touched during the Asian session on Friday, and climbs to the 158.00 neighborhood in the last hour.
FX.reason: USD/JPY bounce as USD steadies — important because JPY is a major funding/safe-haven driver; moves tied to US NFP and global risk sentiment.

FX.title: Taiwan’s Currency Weakens Past 33 Per US Dollar on AI Jitters
FX.reason: TWD breaking a notable threshold amid AI-related risk-off — EMFX weakening vs USD supports the broader dollar-strength and regional FX stress narrative.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah struggles as Asian forex shifts
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 18,140 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces headwinds from shifts in Asian foreign exchange markets, largely driven by global risk sentiment and te
FX.reason: EMFX (IDR) under pressure as regional FX reprices on risk sentiment — relevant to USD-flow and broader Asian FX weakness.

FX.title: Swiss Franc remains steady amid safe-haven demand
FX.summary: USD/CHF remains flat after recovering daily losses, trading around 0.8170 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair has pared its daily losses as the US Dollar (USD) gained support amid widespread market caution.
FX.reason: CHF safe-haven flow noted, but the article highlights USD support; included for cross-check on safe-haven interplay though the signal is modest.

Commodities.title: Gold eases on inflation worries from higher oil; US payrolls data in focus
Commodities.reason: Gold headline: market weakness tied to near-term macro catalysts (higher oil/inflation worries, US payrolls) implies modest near-term selling pressure. Reuters piece is market-moving but not a deep structural call, so medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold rises to near $4,100 ahead of US NFP data
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) jumps to a more than two-week high near $4,085 during the early Asian session on Friday, bolstered by a weaker US Dollar (USD) and lower oil prices. Traders will closely monitor the US September employment report for clues on rate policy,

Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to intraday losses around $4,050 during the early European session on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) builds on its bounce from the lowest level since late September, which it touched the previous day.

Commodities.title: Gold Set for Biggest Weekly Gain Since August After US Midterms
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg takes a broader market view showing weekly gold upside after political event risk — a meaningful thematic move. High relevance and a clear bullish regime signal for gold this week.

Commodities.title: Goldman lowers year-end gold price forecast on hawkish Fed shift
Commodities.reason: Major sell-side forecast downgrade tied to a hawkish Fed is a material negative for gold expectations; relevance is above average given Goldman’s influence on market expectations.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD retakes $52.00 as bulls seem hesitant ahead of US NFP

Commodities.title: Copper Moves Lower as US Election Undermines AI and Tariff Trade
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg links copper weakness to a weaker demand narrative (election impacts on AI/tariff trade) — a clear negative for industrial metals with above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: Refineries have shifted production away from gasoline to middle distillates
Commodities.summary: Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026. Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly—which includes data through August 2026—indicate refinery yields
Commodities.reason: EIA data shows refineries favoring distillates (diesel/jet) over gasoline due to margins — supportive for middle distillate prices and indicative of product tightness; high-relevance supply-side data.

Commodities.title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
Commodities.summary: Global crude oil refinery inputs fell by 4.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), or 6%, following the start of conflict in late February in the Middle East, according to data from Kpler. Throughput then increased by 1.8 million
Commodities.reason: EIA/Kpler data showing significant refinery throughput drops linked to Middle East conflict is a material supply-side bullish factor for oil/products; high relevance.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins

Commodities.title: WTI sticks to gains above $90.00 as US-Iran tensions persist; lacks bullish conviction

Commodities.title: Oil Heads for Steep Weekly Loss as Mideast Peace Prospects Rise

Commodities.title: Brazil Puts Rare Earths, Copper Atop Critical Minerals List

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is resilient, but leverage is missing and demand still tepid

Crypto.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says

Crypto.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
Crypto.reason: Protocol upgrade that improves privacy and payment speed is a positive fundamental for Zcash utility and adoption — constructive for native token demand.
